text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――...Mm.
That's all of 'em.

One day. Air Shakur suddenly hauled
a mountain of cardboard boxes into the Trainer's Office.
choice_data_list: Sh-Shakaal-san? What in the world is this...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it.
Get rid of the stuff we don't need.
I didn't really understand, but I agreed to hold onto it and checked the contents for now. Everything was unopened and appeared just as it was when delivered.

The contents were... absolute "chaos."
Just when you thought it was stuffed with junk food snacks, there were also healthy organic foods mixed in...

Pseudoscience wellness goods alongside cutting-edge science magazines.
A childish patterned towel next to a chic handkerchief.
Amid such a chaotic jumble, what caught my eye was—

Inside what looked like a bar, a young, frail-looking
Umamusume was cradling a child. On the back of the photo,
a certain message was written...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah.
It's all stuff my mom sent over.”

A few days later, I asked Air Shakur about it out of curiosity,
and she readily admitted it was an allowance sent from home.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The contents are pretty much what I expected, too. Seriously pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For now, they probably just wanna go through
the motions of actin' like parents.
That's why there's no damn theme or rhyme or reason to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Such weird choices like towels and photos must be a hint to go back to how things used to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Before I was old enough to know better, she'd quietly dress me up in whatever she liked.
Guess she misses the days when I just did what I was told.

Her tone was different from usual.
A way of speaking with clear hostile intent... A massive rift seemed to exist between her and her mother.
choice_data_list: (Passing that message along might just add fuel to the fire...)

text_block_list.text:
On the back of the photo of the two snuggling close, it read...
'At least tell me what I should do.
Please understand how I feel.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I can't even remember the last time we had a real conversation.
Even an idiot can tell I'm being shut out."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...She's the one who threw her hands up
and gave up first with "I don't get it."
She should've just left it at that.

A thought crosses my mind. Why was the care package so
haphazard...? Could it be because she didn't know what was needed,
so this was the result of her racking her brains?
"Please understand how I feel"—that voice seeking understanding might also hold a wish for simply a chance to talk.
choice_data_list: True, you might not understand, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's still a sign that she wants to do something to help.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Like hell it is.
Even if that were true, I don't need you forcing it on me.

I didn't want to pry any deeper into their personal issues.
So, deciding to change the subject—
choice_data_list: Where did you take that photo?
Where did you take that photo?
Even so, that amount of cardboard boxes...

text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to pry any deeper into their personal issues.
So, deciding to change the subject—
choice_data_list: Where did you take that photo?
Where did you take that photo?
Even so, that amount of cardboard boxes...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The bar where Mom used to work back in the day.
choice_data_list: So your mother was a bartender.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like she could be that skillful.
It's singing, just singing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Word is, she was singing for drunks in the corner of some tiny little dive bar."

It turns out her mother was apparently a singer.
I'm curious about the details, but Air Shakur doesn't seem to want to talk about it anymore.

Looking at the photo again, the mother had
a gentle face, but Air Shakur had looked
sharp and fierce even back then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Bratty kids around this age are pretty much all the same, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Speaking of which, those clothes.
They've got a crap-ton of frills on 'em.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I hated it so much that the second my mom took it off,
I ripped it to absolute shreds.
Man, I remember how hard she cried over that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And the way she cries, too... Staring right at me, tears just pouring down without making a sound... Seriously, give me a break.

...I wonder if the day will come
when Air Shakur and her mother can finally talk things out.
Such thoughts crossed my mind.

This is too much volume to have built up in just a day or two.
Could it be...
choice_data_list: You haven't opened it once since they started sending care packages?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait.
I did open it just once before."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not me.
Doto.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Seems she mistook it for something addressed to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dunno why, but there was a super spicy snack in there, and she scarfed it down in seconds.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She keeps apologizing like crazy and gets super depressed.
Having someone like that in your room is totally annoying, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "So when I said, 'Actually, I'd rather you eat it. I'll give ya the rest too,' they looked kinda happy..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —It was after that day that she started talking to me...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's seriously a mystery.

Things like that were probably a daily occurrence.
I felt like I caught a glimpse of why
Meisho Doto was so attached to Air Shakur.
